description: The whole job-search filter contract, one entry per filter: its name, type, the values it accepts or the lookup tool that supplies them, its `exclude_` twin, where it goes in the `POST /api/jobs/search` JSON body with an example fragment, and the matching `jobo` CLI flag. Read it before writing request-building code or types: several filters are spelled differently in the body (`work_model` is `work_models`, `q` is `queries`), and include/exclude filters are nested objects, where a flat `skills_exclude` key is ignored without an error. No API key and no network call: it answers from the filter contract this server ships with.
name: describe_search_filters
title: Describe the search filters
